briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and Google Gemini 3 race ahead in multi-agent benchmarks amid escalating compute arms race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with new model releases this month. Compute shortages persist while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally. DialectForge gains traction in enterprise security pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with advanced agentic capabilities. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 and Meta's Llama 4.1 push context windows beyond 2M tokens. DeepSeek R2 undercuts pricing on reasoning tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with new fines for frontier models.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays while Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters. TSMC expands Arizona fabs for custom AI silicon.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve reliable self-improvement before 2028 or trigger new alignment crises?
